title: Case board
intro: Each arrow tests whether a linked change is consistent with this trend, in the same place and the same years. A consistent link is no proof of a cause.
no_board: No case board exists for this variable yet.
live_off: The live case board is off for now. The two demo cases still show their boards.

reasons.registry_status: The registry marks this link as one that NASA POWER cannot test.
reasons.remote_area: This link names a remote area, which this version does not test yet.
reasons.focus_differs: This link is written for another measure of the focus variable.
reasons.too_few_overlap_years: The two series share too few years for the test.
reasons.constant_series: One of the two series does not change, so it gives no correlation.
reasons.n_eff_out_of_range: The years carry over so strongly that too few independent values remain for the test.
reasons.metric_switched: One side switched to counting event days, so the test would not compare like with like.
reasons.other: This link cannot be tested here.

directions.same: Both change in the same direction
directions.opposite: The two change in opposite directions
